The '''Kerestian sun''' was a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by [[Kerest/Legends|Kerest]] and other [[Planet/Legends|planets]], which were themselves orbited by the habitable [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Pharna]] and [[Karoliston]]. An unusual period of inactivity of the sun forced the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestians]] to abandon their colonies on these moons.<ref name="GG12" />
